def read_input():
    line = input().split()
    return line

    h = int(line[1])
    array_nodes_minheigt = [[0 for x in range(36)] for y in range(36)]

    for nodes in range(1,36):
        for minheight in range(0,nodes+1):

                left = topnode-1
                right = nodes - topnode

                (array_nodes_minheigt[left][0]-array_nodes_minheigt[left][max(minheight-1,0)])* \
                (array_nodes_minheigt[right][0]-array_nodes_minheigt[right][max(minheight-1,0)])
    return array_nodes_minheigt, n, h

def main():
    line = read_input()
    array_nodes_minheigt, n, h = process_input(line)
